title: A template's repeated blocks are on one sheet, shared formulas and `x14` conditional formats are not moved, and an `Iterator` is not a list.
text: Closing it repeats blocks on more than one sheet, gives each copy of a shared formula its own `si`, shifts an `x14` conditional format under `extLst`, and takes an `Iterator` as a list in `$data` (`rule:core-classes/spreadsheet-template-fill`).
